name: Security Deposit
query:
SELECT jea.cost_center AS "Cost Center:Link/Cost Center:150",
       jea.party AS "Party:Link/Customer:200",
       pr.name AS "Property:Link/Property:160",
       CONCAT(pr.bedroom, ' BHK') AS "BHK::70",
       jea.account_currency AS "Currency::70",
       FORMAT(SUM(jea.debit_in_account_currency - jea.credit_in_account_currency) * -1, 2) AS "Amount::120"
FROM `tabJournal Entry Account` jea
INNER JOIN `tabJournal Entry` je ON je.name = jea.parent
LEFT JOIN `tabProperty` pr ON jea.cost_center = pr.cost_center
WHERE jea.docstatus = '1'
  AND (%(account)s IS NULL OR %(account)s = '' OR jea.account = %(account)s)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR je.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR je.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(property)s IS NULL OR %(property)s = '' OR pr.name = %(property)s)
  AND (%(tenant)s IS NULL OR %(tenant)s = '' OR jea.party = %(tenant)s)
  AND (%(unit)s IS NULL OR %(unit)s = '')
GROUP BY jea.cost_center, jea.party
